description: I'm Sidak Mann, a Brophy sophomore and founder of Strygonia, building BlackBox, a systems debugging device. I've built GhostLink (encrypted messaging), RomExplorer (Android), a Fortran compiler, and wheresmywater.org (featured on ABC15, 6,000+ visitors). I code in C++, TypeScript, HTML, and Python, and know AI. Seeking: data analysis, ML, visualization, UI/UX, space medicine, writing. Beginners welcome.
